2023
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil Secrett. Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Dhananjai Kumar Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.208 of 2023 under sections 363, 376(3) Ipc
and section 3/4(2) Pocso Act, P.S. Fakharpur, District Bahraich.
3.

entities.text: Pocso Act, P.S. Fakharpur, District Bahraich
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Initially the first information report was lodged under section 363 IPC.
Subsequently, in the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C, the victim stated that she had gone out of her own freewill and was in love with the applicant.

Similar statement was under section 164 Cr.P.C.
4.
The counsel for the applicant, in support of the proof of age, placed reliance upon Aadhar Card wherein the date of birth of the victim was recorded as 17.01.2005.

It is also argued that the Aslam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil ... on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145316637/
1 applicant and the victim have already married.

entities.text: Aslam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: While rejecting the bail application, the court below relied upon the certificate issued by the school depicting the age of the victim as 17.04.2011.
The counsel for the applicant argues that the said certificate was a procured one and has been issued at the instance of the informant only with a view to prosecute the applicant.

5. Learned AGA argues that the applicant is in custody only since one month and the medical report shows that the hymen to be torn and thus, there is medical evidence against the applicant, as such,
the bail application should be rejected.
6.

Considering the submissions made at the bar what transpires is that the victim as per her statement under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has not supported the prosecution story, the proof of marriage is on record and with regard to age in view of the law laid down by this Court in the case of Monish vs. State of U.P. and others decided on 09.02.2023 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.55026 of 2021 and keeping in view the credible opposition to the said certificate issued by the school, the same is to be determined at the time of trial coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents, the applicant is entitled for the bail.

entities.text: Monish vs. State of U.P. and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.55026 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Thus, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Aslam be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 20.7.2023 VNP/-
